description: Explain what a Standard Numbering System (SNS) code means in a BREX: pass a DMC (the system / subsystem / sub-subsystem / assembly codes are taken from it) or the codes directly. Returns the matched hierarchy with titles; "exact: false" means only a prefix matched.

brex.description: Which BREX to use: a file path to a BREX data module (.xml), or a DMC (e.g. "KENBAIKI-A-00-00-00-00A-022A-D", "DMC-" prefix optional) searched in csdbDirs / S1000D_CSDB_DIR / S1000D_SPEC_DIR. Omit to use the S1000D default BREX found under S1000D_SPEC_DIR.

csdbDirs.description: CSDB folders to search for BREX by DMC (default: S1000D_CSDB_DIR / the config file; S1000D_SPEC_DIR is always searched for the S1000D default BREX). When given, these folders replace S1000D_CSDB_DIR and the csdbDirs of the config file (they are not added to them); folders that do not exist are skipped and reported in _notes.

dmc.description: A DMC whose SNS part should be looked up.

systemCode.description: System code (2-3 characters), when not passing dmc.

name: lookup_sns
